CreateDataSet
Method.Description: Server-side callback to provide data for the dynaGrid.
Method.Implementation:
Do pDataSet.%Clear()
#; fill in contents of dataSet #; This is a 2-D data structure
#; row labels (dimension 1) Do pDataSet.%SetLabel("Static",1,1) Do pDataSet.%SetLabel("Host",2,1) Do pDataSet.%SetLabel("Adapter",3,1)
#; column labels (dimension 2) Do pDataSet.%SetLabel("Key",1,2) Do pDataSet.%SetLabel("Value",2,2)
#; find size of dataSet Set rows = pDataSet.%GetDimSize(1) Set cols = pDataSet.%GetDimSize(2)
Do pDataSet.%SetValue("File",1,1) Do pDataSet.%SetValue("Not Selected",1,2) Quit $$$OK

Method.name: saveDataSet
Method.Implementation:
set retStr = "" Set pDataSet = pGrid.dataSet
#; find size of dataSet Set rows = pDataSet.%GetDimSize(1) Set cols = pDataSet.%GetDimSize(2) set crFl = ##class(IHC.ITF.SrcCtrlPkg.CreateSettingFiles).%New() set fileNm = crFl.DeployDirectory _ crFl.SettingDirectory _ env _"/" _ nmSp _ "-" _ comp _ "-" _ env _".txt"
set file = ##class(%File).%New(fileNm) set stat = file.Open("WN") if ($$$ISOK(stat)) { Do file.WriteLine("# Settings file for: " _ comp _ ", Namepsace: " _ nmSp _ ", Environment: " _ env) #; Get in data For r=1:1:rows { set setting = pDataSet.%GetLabel(r,1) set key = pDataSet.%GetValue(r,1,1) set value = pDataSet.%GetValue(r,2,1)
Do file.WriteLine( setting _ " #$# " _ key _"#$# "_value) } Do file.Close() set retStr = "Created file: " _ fileNm } else { set retStr = "Could not create file: " _ fileNm }
return retStr

Method.name: CheckInSettingFile
Method.Implementation:
Do ##class(IHC.ITF.SrcCtrlPkg.EnsembleSrcCtrlClass).CheckSvnSetup($get(%session.Data("UsNm")), $get(%session.Data("PsWd"))) Do ##class(IHC.ITF.ITFCOMMON.Utility).WriteToFileWithUserNm($get(%session.Data("UsNm")), "CheckInSettingFile: " _ comp) set statStr = "" set crFl = ##class(IHC.ITF.SrcCtrlPkg.CreateSettingFiles).%New()
set stat = crFl.checkInFile(nmSp, comp, env, cmt, $get(%session.Data("UsNm")), $get(%session.Data("PsWd")), .statStr) set retStr = "CheckIn File output: " _ stat _ "; " _ statStr
RETURN retStr
